title: Offer replacement-root directory recovery only when current central authority is available
outcome: A missing or mismatched directory-row diagnostic does not direct the caller to another root when the current central condition would refuse that root as well.
acceptance: Replacement-root guidance is conditional on current central authority succeeding; unavailable, continuity-lost, quarantined or non-durable conditions retain honest condition-specific recovery without changing the original refusal status, kind or binding.

Behavioral fixtures combine a missing or mismatched row with unavailable central authority, then healthy authority, and show guidance follows the current condition while original caller identity and fences remain intact.
